source: 717 Supervision?
target: 717 Supervisio?

source: 717 Supervision?
target: 717 Supervisio?

source: “Why did he just blow up like that?” Lumian muttered, frowning as he watched the blood slowly soaking into the soil.
target: “Cur ille ita subito erupit?” Lumian submurmuravit, frontem contritum habens dum vidit sanguinem lente in terram imbuiri.

source: He gripped the carbide lamp tightly.
target: Lucernam carbidicam firmiter arripuit.

source: His two questions hadn’t been intended to end Jebus’s life.
target: Duae quaestiones non erant destinatae ad vitam Iebus interficiendam.

source: He had simply wanted to carefully test the limits, one step at a time.
target: Ipse voluit limites caute experiri, unum post unum.

source: Anthony calmly explained, “The fundamental rule of hypnosis is to never directly threaten the subject’s life. So when Jebus was asked something that would seriously endanger him, he either would refuse to answer or the shock would jolt him awake, breaking the hypnotic hold.”
target: Anthony tranquille explicavit: “Regula fundamentalis hypnosi est ut numquam directe vitam subiecti minetur. Ita, cum Iebus aliquis quaesitus esset quo grave periculum ei inferret, aut responsum negare oportebat aut ictus eum excitare ad evigilandum moveret, vinculum hypnosi dissolvens.”

source: “I was ready for the possibility of him breaking free from the hypnosis,” Lumian said, having anticipated this outcome.
target: “Paratus eram ad facultatem ut ex hypnosi vinculis effugeret,” inquit Lumian, hoc eventum praevidens.

source: Jebus couldn’t dodge the Spell of Harrumph at that range.
target: Iebus incantationem “Harrumph” in hoc spatio evadere non potuit.

source: Lumian also had three ritualistic dog skins and a cow hide in his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Lumian etiam tres pelles caninae rituales et unam corium vaccae in sacculo viatoris habebat.

source: Since becoming an Ascetic, he could now craft the mystical animal hides required for the Animal Creation Spell himself.
target: Ex quo asceticus factus est, iam ipse pelles animales mysticas, quae incantationi ad creandum animalia requiruntur, conficere poterat.

source: So he had imbued extra powers into the ones he already possessed.
target: Ita extra potentias in eas, quas iam habebat, infusserat.

source: Thinking back on what had transpired, Jenna mused, “Jebus was going to answer at first… Meaning he didn’t think those two questions would put his life at risk. Heh, guess things didn’t play out like he expected.”
target: Retrospiciens quae acciderant, Jenna meditata dixit: “Primum Iebus respondi velle videbatur… Quod significat eum non credidisse has duas quaestiones vitam eius in periculum adducere. Heh, videtur res non se evenisse ut speraverat.”

source: Franca nodded.
target: Franca annuit.

source: “Exactly. If it was truly dangerous, he could’ve just stayed quiet.”
target: “Certe. Si vere periculosum fuisset, potuisset tacere.”

source: “I assumed he was under some contract where revealing the School of Truth’s headquarters or his direct Overseer’s name would cause his shadow to attack his soul.
target: Existimabam eum sub aliquo pacto esse, in quo revelatio sedis Scholae Veritatis aut nominis directi Supervisoris eius umbram ad animam oppugnandam provocare posset.

source: “Damn, what if his Overseer sneaked in extra terms when the contract was signed? Could that be why Jebus had no clue answering would be risky? Heavens, how tragic is that? Nothing but lies and trickery through and through—are we dealing with Swindlers or Brokers here?”
target: Heu, quid si Supervisor extra conditiones, cum pactum signaretur, subdole inseruisset? Num id est causae quod Iebus nesciret responsum dare periculosum futurum esse? Heu, quam tristis res! Nihil nisi mendacia et dolus in omnibus—num fraudatores an mercatores hic versamur?

source: After Franca’s lament, Lumian considered for a few moments.
target: Post lamentationem Francae, Lumian paucis momentis meditatus est.

source: “Overseer.”
target: “Supervisor.”

source: “Overseer?” Franca caught on immediately.
target: “Supervisor?” Franca statim intellexit.

source: “Overseeing subordinates is an Overseer ability, but Jebus didn’t know that.
target: Superintendere subditos est munus Supervisoris, sed Iebus id nesciebat.

source: Did he set off some forbidden conditions by answering key questions?”
target: Num quaestionibus clavis respondendo conditiones vetitas provocavit?

source: Jenna snapped to attention.
target: Jenna subito animadvertit.

source: “You think the Overseer spotted us already? Could they be on their way?”
target: Existimasne Supervisor iam nos conspexisse? Num in via veniendi sint?

source: “Unlikely. I had Franca leave the Primordial Demoness figurine here after noticing Jebus’s strange reaction,” Lumian said, smiling.
target: “Improbabile. Francam reliquisse figuram Demonissae Primordialis hic, postquam reactionem insolitam Iebus animadverti,” inquit Lumian subridentes.

source: “Even if we’re right, the Overseer probably just detected an issue with Jebus, not our precise location. The real problem is we may need to change our plans going forward.”
target: “Etiam, si recte sentimus, Supervisor verisimiliter solum rem in Iebus deprehendit, non nostrum locum exactum. Vera quaestio est: fortasse consilia nostra in futurum mutanda erunt.”

source: Jenna and Anthony understood what Lumian meant.
target: Jenna et Anthony intellexerunt quid Lumian significaret.

source: They weren’t under imminent threat or at risk of the Overseer tracking them down.
target: Non erant in periculo proximo nec minati erant ut Supervisor eos sequeretur.

source: But something had happened to Jebus, who was guarding Moran Avigny in the mirror world.
target: Sed aliquid factum erat cum Iebus, qui Moran Avigny in mundo speculi custodiebat.

source: Once the Overseer realized, they would easily deduce that someone was after Moran Avigny and undoubtedly take action.
target: Quam ob rem, cum Supervisor id cognovisset, facile concluderet aliquem post Moran Avigny esse et sine dubio rem capere.

source: The scheme they had so carefully devised probably no longer fit the new circumstances.
target: Consilium, quod tam diligenter paraverant, verisimiliter novis condicionibus iam non conveniebat.

source: Franca sighed heavily, eyeing the bone figurine on the ground with genuine regret.
target: Franca graviter suspiravit, figuram ossis in terra positam cum sincera paenitentia intuens.

source: “I resisted when the Demoness of Black first gave me this figurine. Now I’m wishing she’d given me a dozen!”
target: “Recusavi, cum Demonissa Nigra primum hanc figuram mihi dederit. Nunc opto ut mihi duodecim dederit!”

source: Poking fun at herself, she stooped down to retrieve the Primordial Demoness figurine.
target: Ludens de se, inclinavit ut figuram Demonissae Primordialis reciperet.

source: She delicately cleaned it off and murmured appreciatively.
target: Illam leniter purgavit et suaviter murmuratudine aestimativa submurmuravit.

source: Lumian took stock of his own actions.
target: Lumian suas actiones contemplatus est.

source: “I should’ve been watching how Jebus’s fate tributary shifted using the Eye of Calamity. Maybe then I could’ve intervened in time to stop him from responding.”
target: “Debuī observare quomodo fatum Iebus per usum Oculi Calamitas mutatum esset; fortasse tum in tempore intercedere potuissem, ut eum responsione prohibuerem.”

source: He hadn’t anticipated Jebus being oblivious to which questions would violate a taboo.
target: Non praedixit Iebus nesciens esse quaestiones quas omnino vetitas esse oporteret.

source: This wasn’t about religious devotion or advanced mystical knowledge.
target: Hoc non pertinebat ad devotionem religiosam neque ad scientiam mysticam provectam.

source: Jebus ought to have known what he could and couldn’t say.
target: Iebus debuisset scire quae verba dicere liceret et quae non.

source: If not, his daily life would’ve been cut short many times over.
target: Alioquin, vita eius cotidiana pluries celeriter interclusa fuisset.

source: Franca remembered, “The School of Truth member Jenna and I ran into before had the same thing happen when we asked his organizational affiliation and why he was capitalizing on the gatekeeper vanishing.
target: Franca recordavit: “Meminimus, cum Jenna, membrum Scholae Veritatis, et ego eum ante convenisse, idem evenisse, cum rogavimus de eius coniunctione et cur absentia custodiae portae ad lucrum converteretur.

source: Based on Jebus’s answer, stating ‘the School of Truth’ itself isn’t forbidden.
target: Ex responsione Iebus, in qua declarabat ‘Schola Veritatis’ ipsa non esse vetitum,

source: And I bet the guy who wasn’t even an Ambitionist yet had no idea why he was exploiting the gatekeeper’s absence.
target: et credo eum, qui ne Ambitionista quidem erat, nescire cur absentia custodiae portae ad lucrum converteretur.”

source: “Seems it really is an Overseer ability after all. No wonder the taboos are fluid, with the context, mental state, and overall situation determining what crosses the line each time. The rules adapt to the circumstances. Heh, just like the ideology Jebus described.”
target: “Videtur re vera facultas Supervisoris esse. Non mirum tabuae sint mutabiles, cum contextu, statu mentis, et universa condicione decernatur quid limitem transgrediantur. Heh, sicut ipsa ideologia quam Iebus enarravit.”

source: Lumian gave a small nod and laughed.
target: Lumian parvum annuit et risit.

source: “Well, at least we secured the spoils early on. Would’ve been a huge waste otherwise.”
target: “Bene, saltem praeda initio obtinuimus. Alioquin ingens perditum fuisset.”

source: He thought for a bit.
target: Pauca meditatus est.

source: “Franca, contact the Demoness of Black with the charm later. Inform her about the fixed mirror world entrance we made, what occurred, and how Jebus reacted. See what she thinks and advises."
target: “Franca, postea hoc amuleto utens, Demonissam Nigram continge. Nuntiā ei de fixo ingressu in mundum speculi, quem fecimus, de rebus evenientibus, et de modo quo Iebus respondit. Vide quid sentiat et suadeat.”

source: “Right, she’s likely a Tamara from the Apprentice branch. No love lost between her and Moran Avigny, who defected from the Judgement branch.”
target: “Recte, verisimiliter ea est Tamara ex ramo Discipulorum. Nullum amorem inter eam et Moran Avigny, qui ex ramo Iudicii discesserat, intersit.”

source: Franca concurred, and Lumian turned to Jenna next.
target: Franca assentivit, et Lumian deinde ad Jenna se convertit.

source: “Head to the safehouse and send word to Madam Judgment. The Judgement pathway stands for order, so I feel we must alert her to the School of Truth situation at once. I’ll take you there.”
target: “Vade ad refugium et mitte nuntium ad Madam Judgment. Via Iudicii ordinem significat, ergo mihi videtur nos eam statim de re Scholae Veritatis certiorem facere debere. Te illic ducam.”

source: “Got it.” Jenna was accustomed to Lumian delegating tasks in moments like these.
target: “Intellectum.” Jenna consuebat Lumian huiusmodi munera delegare.

source: Finally, Lumian addressed Anthony.
target: Denique, Lumian ad Anthony locutus est.

source: “Join me at the Pleasure Pavilion to await Moran Avigny’s arrival. Watch him closely for any unusual behavior.”
target: “Mecum ad Pavillionem Voluptatis adiunge ut adventum Moran Avigny exspectemus. Eum diligenter observa, si quid insolitum morum occurrat.”

source: Situated on Avenue du Boulevard, the opulent Pavilion of Pleasure functioned as the Intis Republic’s presidential estate.
target: In Avenue du Boulevard sito, opulentus Pavillionem Voluptatis functus est ut praesidentialis residens Reipublicae Intis.

source: Moran Avigny was due to attend a ministerial meeting convened by the president there.
target: Moran Avigny ad conventum ministrorum, a praeside ibi convocatum, compareturus erat.

source: Anthony inclined his head slightly to convey his assent.
target: Anthony caput leviter inclinavit, ut suam assentientiam exprimere posset.

source: Observation was a Spectator’s forte, after all.
target: Observatio erat ars Spectatoris, post omnia.

source: Inside the quarry cave housing the mirror world’s fixed entryway,
target: Intra speluncam lapidariam, quae ingressum fixum in mundum speculi continet,

source: Franca leaned against the wall, her night vision active.
target: Franca ad murum inclinata est, cum visio nocturna eius activa esset.

source: She produced a compact and a charm fashioned from ashen stone.
target: Parvum compactum et amuletum ex lapide cinereo factum extraxit.

source: Clasping the charm, Franca infused it with her spirituality.
target: Amuletum stringens, Franca illud cum sua spiritualitate infudit.

source: Reciting the Hermes activation phrase, she intoned,
target: Recitans verba activationis Hermetis, inquit,

source: “Eyes!”
target: “Oculi!”

source: Wreathed in obsidian flames, the rock-like grayish charm flared to life.
target: Circumdatus flammis obsidianis, amuletum, quasi lapide cinereo, in vitam exarsit.

source: Franca touched it to the compact’s glass,
target: Franca illud ad vitrum compacti tetigit,

source: causing the mirror to lose solidity and turn incorporeal.
target: causans ut speculum soliditatem amitteret et incorporeum fieret.

source: The burning charm sank through without resistance, vanishing from sight.
target: Amuletum ardens sine repugnatione delapsum est, conspectum amittens.

source: Moments later, Franca sensed a presence surround her.
target: Paucis momentis post, Franca sensit praesentiam eam circumvenire.

source: A mass of dark locks then rose from the makeup mirror’s surface.
target: Massa capillorum obscurorum ex superficie speculi apparuit.

source: The rippling black tresses obscured her view.
target: Undantes crines nigrae eius conspectum obtexuerunt.

source: As the hair fully emerged, Franca tightened her grasp, and Clarice took form before her.
target: Cum crines plene apparuissent, Franca manum contraxit, et Clarice coram ea formam accepit.

source: The Demoness of Black’s own hair remained immaculately tied up, with no trace of the ominous raven strands.
target: Crines ipsius Demonissae Nigrae immaculate alligati manebant, sine ullo vestigio crinitum corvinorum.

source: Even having met her prior, Franca couldn’t suppress a rush of awe at Clarice’s allure.
target: Etiam cum eam ante convenisset, Franca flumen admirationis ob Claricee formositatem reprimere non potuit.

source: The woman possessed a breathtaking beauty that effortlessly ensnared any who beheld her.
target: Femina pulchritudine eximia praedita erat, quae facile omnem qui eam conspexit captivabat.

source: Clarice regarded Franca, her melodic voice gentle as she inquired, “You have an update?”
target: Clarice Francam respexit, voce dulci et leni, quaerens: “Habesne nuntium novum?”

source: Composing herself, Franca detailed her suspicion of corruption seeping out of Underground Trier.
target: Se componens, Franca enarravit suspicioni de corruptione ex Underground Trier effluentis.

source: She had ventured to a particular sector bearing the Primordial Demoness figurine, ultimately pinpointing the target site.
target: Ad aliquem sectorem pervenit, figuram Demonissae Primordialis ferens, et denique locum propositum designavit.

source: She elaborated on beseeching the Primordial One via the figurine, obtaining a reply, and securing a permanent gateway to the mirror plane.
target: Explicavit quomodo per figuram Primordiae orationem fecerit, responsum obtinuerit, atque ianuam permanentem ad planum speculi assecuraverit.

source: A rare glimmer of approval showed on Clarice’s face.
target: Rara scintilla approbationis in facie Clarice apparuit.

source: “Your instincts are sharp and your mind keen.
target: “Instincta tua acuta sunt et mens tua perspicax.

source: Impressive that you conceived of and accomplished this.
target: Mirabile est quod id concepisti atque perfecisti.

source: Perhaps you too shall rise to be a colored Demoness one day.
target: Forsitan etiam tu aliquando ad demonissam coloratam exsurges.

source: Demoness of Yellow? Franca grumbled to herself.
target: “Demonissa Flava?” Franca ad se murmurat.

source: She went on to outline the scheme she had hatched with Lumian’s crew, withholding specifics about the Tarot Club and portraying the Mirror Mark power as an item.
target: Deinde continuit consilium, quod cum manipulo Lumiani excogitaverat, detrahens specifica de Tarot Club et vim Signi Speculi tamquam rem exhibens.

source: Clarice listened attentively without comment.
target: Clarice attentive auscultavit, nihil addidens.

source: Franca recounted the offensive against Lumian amid his probe, his triumph over Jebus, and the bounty of intel gleaned through a Spectator.
target: Franca narravit de impetu adversus Lumian dum eum investigaret, de victoria eius super Iebus, atque de copia notitiarum per Spectatorem collectarum.

source: The Demoness of Black nodded.
target: Demonissa Nigra annuit.

source: “Your lovers are quite capable, the Hunter in particular.
target: “Amatores vestri valde capaces sunt, praesertim Venator.

source: Here Clarice smirked.
target: Hic Clarice subridens risit.

source: “The taste of a Hunter isn’t bad either.
target: “Gustus Venatoris quoque non male est.

source: The higher their Sequence, the more intense and brave they grow.”
target: Quo altior eorum series, eo magis intensi et audaces fiunt.

source: Wh— Emperor, even an elite Demoness has perused your clandestine annals… Every Demoness probably owns an edition!
target: Heu— Imperator, etiam una Demonissa electa arcana tua annales perscrutata est… Omnis Demonissa fortasse suam editionem habet!

source: Franca wavered between finding Emperor Roselle’s plight humorous or pitiable.
target: Franca inter iocosum et miserabile casus Imperatoris Roselle vacillabat.

source: “It certainly has its perks,” Franca played along, smiling and trying to mask her chagrin.
target: “Certe, illa commoditates suas habet,” Franca ludens respondit, subridente et conante dolorem suum celare.

source: The Demoness of Black proceeded, “However, both you and he erred.
target: Demonissa Nigra perrexit: “Sed tamen, et tu et ille erraverunt.

source: “Upon amassing adequate knowledge, you should have ceased questioning without delay. The wiser course was to first ambush Moran Avigny, seize him, then interrogate further.”
target: “Postquam scientiam sufficientem conquisivisses, quaestiones sine mora desinere debuisses; melius erat primum insidiari Moran Avigny, eum capere, deinde ulteriora interrogare.”

source: “Agreed.” Franca accepted the Demoness of Black’s reproach.
target: “Agreed.” Franca assensit reprehensioni demonissae Nigrae.

source: In hindsight, the location of the School of Truth’s headquarters and the presiding Overseer’s identity were not essential facts for their immediate needs.
target: In retrospecto, locus praesidi Scholae Veritatis et identitas praesidis Supervisoris non erant essentiales notitiae ad necessitates eorum praesentes.

source: They could have morphed Jebus into a dog and set Lugano and Ludwig to guard him.
target: Iebum in canem convertere potuissent, et Lugano atque Ludwig ad eum custodiendum statuere potuissent.

source: While the Overseer remained unaware, she and the rest could have lurked within the mirror, poised for Moran Avigny to unwittingly enter of his own accord.
target: Dum Supervisor manebat nescius, illa et ceteri intra speculum latuere potuissent, parati ut Moran Avigny inscius sua sponte accederet.

source: Ample chances to take a second captive would have presented themselves down the line.
target: Multae occasiones ad secundum captivum capiendum se ostenderent deinceps.

source: However, this was Lumian’s style.
target: Attamen, hoc erat via Lumiani.

source: It had long been apparent to Franca that Lumian was predisposed to extracting intelligence on the spot.
target: Iamdudum Francae patebat Lumianum esse promptum notitias in loco extrahere.

source: Only extraordinary reasons would induce him to postpone.
target: Solum causae extraordinariae eum ad differendum coegerunt.

source: As if he feared the slightest delay might thwart him from procuring otherwise obtainable insight.
target: Velut si minima mora eum impediret ut notitiam aliter obtineret.

source: Demoness of Black Clarice refrained from belaboring the point.
target: Demonissa Nigra Clarice abstinuit rem nimis disserere.

source: Nodding, she declared, “Abide here for my return. I’ll look into these developments, but it may require some time.”
target: Caput inclinans, inquit: “Manete hic usque ad reditum meum. Has res explorabo, sed aliquod tempus id requisitum esse potest.”

source: “As you wish, Madame Clarice.” Franca made no effort to conceal her gratified smile.
target: “Ut velis, Domina Clarice.” Franca nihil fecit ut risum suum laetum celaret.

source: Outside the dazzling Pavilion of Pleasure on Avenue du Boulevard, Lumian and Anthony seamlessly rejoined the throng of journalists.
target: Extra fulgentem Pavillionem Voluptatis in Avenue du Boulevard, Lumian et Anthony celeriter turmam diurnariorum reiunxerunt.
